# Sarfaraz — Full Stack Developer

> Full Stack Developer in Kolkata, India building fast, modern web applications
> with Next.js and Laravel. This site is a personal portfolio: profile, work
> history, skills, and selected projects with links to source and live demos.

## About

Sarfaraz is a Full Stack Developer specializing in Next.js and Laravel,
building scalable, high-performance web applications with clean, maintainable
code and a focus on user experience. Location: Kolkata, India.

## Projects

- [Motus Gym Management](https://sarfaraz.fyi/#projects): Gym management system — memberships, billing, and attendance.
- [Audiophile](https://sarfaraz.fyi/#projects): Audio e-commerce storefront with cart and checkout.
- [Frontend Mentor Challenges](https://sarfaraz.fyi/#projects): Responsive challenge solutions.
- [Snapcast](https://sarfaraz.fyi/#projects): Screen and audio sharing app.
- [Finco](https://sarfaraz.fyi/#projects): Personal finance dashboard.
- [Developer Portfolio](https://sarfaraz.fyi/#projects): This site — React, Vite, and Tailwind CSS.

## Skills

Next.js, React.js, Node.js, Laravel, React Native, Tailwind CSS, PostgreSQL,
MongoDB, Docker, TypeScript, JavaScript, PHP, SQL, InertiaJS, Electron,
SQLite, Git, Figma.
